describe: return focus when opened from a popup item
exceptions.title: returns focus to the $name trigger
exceptions.reason: Two rows of the case press the trigger of Menu to open the menu. The trigger of Vase UI has no press yet.

exceptions.title: respects finalFocus when initialFocus points outside the popup
exceptions.reason: With `modal` set to `true`, the elements outside the popup are inert (BUG-4678), so `initialFocus` cannot focus an element outside the popup. The case `BUG-4678: keeps the initial focus off an inert element, and returns the focus to $name` tests this, and the return of the focus.

exceptions.title: moves final focus to trigger if initialFocus points outside the popup and finalFocus is not specified
exceptions.reason: With `modal` set to `true`, the elements outside the popup are inert (BUG-4678), so `initialFocus` cannot focus an element outside the popup. The case `BUG-4678: keeps the initial focus off an inert element, and returns the focus to $name` tests this, and the return of the focus.

exceptions.title: should not throw "Maximum update depth exceeded" when Suspense boundary is outside Portal
exceptions.reason: The case guards a render loop of React (issue 3695) while a `Suspense` boundary outside the portal waits for a lazy component in the popup. The portal of Vase UI renders its content after the mount, so a Vue `<Suspense>` around it does not wait for that content and shows no fallback.

exceptions.title: does not warn for a detached payload open in production
exceptions.reason: The case needs a production build. Vitest sets `process.env.NODE_ENV` when it transforms a file for a browser, so only the Node project can change it. The case `ignores openWithPayload() with no root and gives no warning in a production build` tests the same.

exceptions.title: does not attach a replacement root store from an abandoned transition render
exceptions.reason: The case tests a render that React starts with `startTransition` and drops. Vue has no `startTransition`. In the nearest Vue form, a second root with the same handle in a pending `<Suspense>` branch attaches its store in `onBeforeMount`. Until Vue resolves or drops the branch, `handle.isOpen` and the trigger read that store.

exceptions.title: keeps the root attached through Strict Mode effect replay
exceptions.reason: The case tests React Strict Mode. Vue has no Strict Mode.

exceptions.title: should not dismiss the dialog when dismissing outside a nested modal menu
exceptions.reason: The case presses the trigger of Menu to open the menu. The trigger of Vase UI has no press yet.

exceptions.title: should not close the parent menu when Escape is pressed in a nested dialog
exceptions.reason: The case presses the trigger of Menu to open the menu. The trigger of Vase UI has no press yet.

exceptions.title: closes a popover opened during a nested dialog, not the parent, on Escape after the nested dialog closes
exceptions.reason: The case expects the focus on `<body>` after the nested dialog closes. Vase UI moves it into the parent popup (BUG-6037), so Escape there closes the parent. The case `BUG-6037: on Escape after a nested dialog closes, closes $name` tests Escape with that focus, and with no focus in a popup, where the popover closes as in Base UI.

exceptions.title: returns focus to the menu trigger when a detached dialog trigger unmounts
exceptions.reason: The case presses the trigger of Menu to open the menu. The trigger of Vase UI has no press yet.
